note: Each astronaut is compared with their own baseline: the mean of the last 3 days against the mean of the first 14 days on record. A single odd reading does not change a status. Pattern taken from the team's first prototype.

pattern.note: A statistical model learned from each astronaut's own baseline days. It has only seen simulated data. It can raise a watch, never an alert.

action.text: Look at the listed readings together and repeat any that seem off. No single one has to be wrong for the pattern to matter.

labels.self: You can act on this yourself
labels.ground: Report it to the flight surgeons in the next message to the ground

escalation.note: Watch: the astronaut acts alone. Alert: the crew medical officer is involved. An alert that lasts this many days goes to the ground, in a scheduled message, because a Mars-class mission cannot count on a live conversation with Earth.
